rules.name: Time zone
rules.text: JMA hypocenter times are Japan Standard Time, UTC+9. All origin times converted to UTC before any other step.

rules.name: Coordinates
rules.text: Latitude and longitude are recorded as integer degrees plus decimal minutes, not decimal degrees. Converted before any spatial test.

rules.name: Region
rules.text: Epicentre falls inside a cell of the adopted CSEP-Japan All Japan region, 20,062 cells at 0.1 degree, using cell origins obtained as midpoint minus 0.05 degrees.

rules.name: Depth
rules.text: Depth less than or equal to 100 km, per the published All Japan region definition.

rules.name: Event type
rules.text: Subsidiary information code (column 61) equal to 1, natural earthquake. Excludes artificial events (3), eruption earthquakes and others (4), and low-frequency earthquakes (5).

rules.name: Solution quality
rules.text: Hypocenter determination flag (column 96) not N and not F. Location precision (column 60) not 8.

rules.name: Magnitude scale
rules.text: JMA magnitude per section 3. First magnitude if its type is V, v, D or d; otherwise the second if its type is one of those four; otherwise exclude.

rules.name: Threshold
rules.text: M >= 4.0, with the 0.1 bin convention of section 3 (the M = 4.0 bin covers 3.95 <= M < 4.05).
